title: Chapter 449 Invasion Of The South
content:
Chapter 449 Invasion Of The South

At this time, the strength of the southern countries has already been greatly reduced after the internal friction just now.

In addition, the courts of various countries have been completely destroyed, the royal family has been destroyed, and the administration of various places has fallen into chaos.

Officials of the original local garrison rose up one after another, raising banners to attack each other, hoping to replace the original empire's rule and become the new master of this land.

As for the three victorious empires, although they won the war, they suffered considerable losses, and the territory left by each country was too large to be swallowed by the three kingdoms alone.

Therefore, the Three Kingdoms can only choose to annex one or two surrounding countries, and leave the rest of the territory alone.

Anyway, in the eyes of those in power in these countries, it’s not that they really don’t want the sites they have thrown away, but that they don’t have so much energy now. When the annexed sites are digested and there is enough spare power, sooner or later the sites that are now laissez-faire will be destroyed. Also take it back.

As for whether these sites have been left alone for a long time, whether they will completely break away from their control, and if they really establish several empires on the same spot, it is not in the hearts of the Three Kingdoms Heavenly Immortals.

How can it be so easy to achieve a fairy? Just look at the accumulated luck of the human race from generation to generation for tens of thousands of years. More than two hundred angels can see it.

You know, compared to the seemingly large number of two hundred celestial beings, there are tens of thousands or even more than 100,000 ranks six or seven at the bottom.

Comparing these two quantities, we can know the difficulty.

Almost a hundred seventh-level people can give birth to a fairy, and the difficulty is beyond imagination.

And how many seventh-orders are there in the remaining empires, probably less than one hundred in total?

With such a small base, it is said that within a few years after they were able to digest the territory of the three empires, how many people could successfully break through the boundary between heaven and man and become immortals. The remaining angels who killed the three empires didn't believe it.

Therefore, the three empires are very relieved to let the long-standing warlords of various countries mess around. Whether they are fighting each other or quietly farming, it has nothing to do with the three empires.

When the three empires free up their hands, no matter how well these forces develop, they are just a slightly bigger ant, and their development has also made wedding dresses for the three empires, allowing the three empires to accept Time can be more stable and orderly.

Under such circumstances, Zhong Yu's Yuguo dispatched 5 million troops to the south to crusade against Han and Wei, no, it should be said that they are two areas that have already perished.

It is simply difficult to attract the attention of the three empires.

In their eyes, although Yuguo has developed rapidly in recent years and is like an immortal Xiaoqiang, it does have some ability to survive several conquests by the Ming Dynasty.

But it's just that the eighth-rank Heavenly Immortal of the Ming Dynasty didn't make a move.

If the Heavenly Immortals of the Ming Dynasty really took action and dealt with this small rebellion seriously, the strength displayed by the Yu Kingdom, although compared to the general local forces, is extremely powerful.

Even the savings below the Celestial Immortal have a stronger background than the average empire, but compared to a Celestial Immortal, it is just a lot of effort, nothing to mention.

After all, it's that sentence, if you don't become a fairy, you will end up as an ant.

Without the same level of combat power as a celestial being, no matter how brilliant you are now, it's just fleeting, a flash in the pan, and it won't be long before it disappears.

Therefore, Yuguo is now sending troops to the relics of Han and Wei. Although the three empires have attracted a certain amount of attention, they have not taken it to heart and still let it go.

Even in their hearts, there is such a relatively powerful country to integrate the two countries of Korea and Wei and restore the order there. When the three countries each withdraw their hands and start large-scale expansion again, Yuguo will maintain a good order and develop well. The economy can be completely taken over by the three countries with their strong strength.

Therefore, Yu Guo's action will not arouse the hostility of the Three Kingdoms at all, and will even provide some help.

Because in the eyes of the self-confident Three Kingdoms, no matter how much Yu Guo did, it was nothing more than working for them, and it was free.

In this way, the biggest obstacle to the land expansion of the imperial kingdom, the respective angels of the three kingdoms disappeared.

Zhong Yu's heart was finally let go, and with a good mood, he began to make drastic moves, his expansion plan.

Han and Wei have a vast territory, and they all add up to 47 provinces.

Such a large territory, Zhong Yu wants to swallow it all, naturally it is not so easy, let alone whether his own troops can completely guard it.

It is said that the local warlords entrenched in these places have already reached a certain scale after this period of melee, and it is not so easy to eliminate them.

Therefore, Zhong Yu did not intend to disperse his troops, but concentrated all his troops to focus on attacking one point, first planning to seize a large territory in the south, and then open up the situation before blooming everywhere.

And Zhong Yu's offensive target was placed in the five northern provinces of South Korea.

The five northern provinces of South Korea are the border areas of the original South Korea's Yuyuan Daming. They have always had heavy troops, and they are important bases for South Korea to invade Daming.

In the past, I don't know how many South Korean troops here, passing through the five northern provinces for supplies, and thus easily invaded Ming Dynasty.

When the news of Zhong Yu's invasion came, the warlords in the entire South Korea were shaken. They had heard of Yu Guo's name for a long time, and they were not as unfamiliar with Yu Guo as they imagined.

In the past, there were several confrontations between the Royal Kingdom and the regular army of the Ming Dynasty. Among them, the tragic scale of the battle and the strong mobilization force of the country have already spread to the surrounding countries, which aroused everyone's vigilance.

Today, Yuguo has invaded the homeland of South Korea. Based on the current situation in the homeland of South Korea, it is divided into dozens of powerful warlords, each with tens of thousands of soldiers and horses, and their strength is extremely scattered.

Coupled with the struggle between each other, each has deep contradictions, and it is impossible to unite together. How could such a weak resistance be able to stop the powerful 5 million troops of Yuguo?

Therefore, these princes became panicked, discussing countermeasures among themselves, and wanted to join forces, but because of their respective interests, they could not unite together, and even fought on the spot, consuming part of their strength before the war started.

In the end, when Zhong Yu's army was fighting the enemy, these South Korean princes were still discussing their intention to unite, and they did not form a decent alliance at all.

Under such circumstances, Zhong Yu naturally did not have the slightest scruples, and dispatched troops again and again to capture the five northern provinces in one fell swoop. And took advantage of the situation to march towards the six central provinces, intending to seize the hinterland of South Korea in one fell swoop, and then use this as the center to bloom around and completely annex South Korea.
